aipac.excerpt: works to strengthen the U.S.-Israel partnership
aipac.context: The organization describes lobbying and electoral support for the US-Israel relationship across both US parties.

dmfi.excerpt: DMFI is the home for pro-Israel Democrats: electing Democrats, supporting Israel, strengthening the United States.
dmfi.context: The official mission describes Israel advocacy within Democratic politics. The site explicitly distinguishes DMFI and its PAC as separate organizations.

jstreet.excerpt: JStreetPAC supports pro-Israel, pro-peace, pro-democracy candidates
jstreet.context: Endorsement requirements include Israeli security, US aid governed by US law, Palestinian rights, opposition to occupation/annexation, humanitarian aid and a negotiated Palestinian state. This is relevant context, not a claim of equivalence to AIPAC.

jdca.excerpt: JDCA strongly supports Israel as a Jewish and democratic state.
jdca.context: The official policy supports US security assistance and a two-state outcome, discusses Palestinian rights, and opposes BDS. JDCA and JDCA PAC are separate entities.

rjc.title: Israel - Republican Jewish Coalition
rjc.text: Israel - Republican Jewish Coalition About News Events RJC PAC Legislative Agenda Action Center Membership Donate About News Events RJC PAC Legislative Agenda Action Center Donate Membership Legislative Agenda Israel Home Legislative Agenda Israel The RJC recognizes and supports the existence, legitimacy, and security of the State of Israel. We support strengthening the vital US-Israel alliance; enhancing Israel’s security through military, diplomatic, and strategic assistance ; and fighting alongside Israel against terrorists, the Boycott, Divestment, Sanctions (BDS) movement, and others who seek to delegitimize and destroy her. Oppose BDS HR 867 / S.4296 IGO Anti-Boycott Act Support strict enforcement of the Taylor Force Act S. 198 / HR 1710 PLO and PA Terror Payments Accountability Act Continue current ban on UNRWA funding S. 224 / HR 23 Illegitimate Court Counteraction Act to impose sanctions on persons that aid efforts by the International Criminal Court (ICC) to prosecute Americans or Israelis Support sanctions on individuals or entities that support Hamas, Palestinian Islamic Jihad and other terrorist organizations S. 2293 / HR 4397 Muslim Brotherhood Terrorist Designation Act Support sanctions on individuals or entities that support Hamas, Palestinian Islamic Jihad and other terrorist organizations HR 261 / S. 1904 , the Palestinian International Terrorism Support Prevention Act Support the implementation and expansion of the Abraham Accords Oppose re-opening PLO office in Washington DC Support codification of Trump policy on labeling goods "Made in Israel" Support permanent recognition of Israel’s sovereignty over Golan Heights Spread the Word!
